verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents an embeddable in-page feedback widget where users describe a problem and send it, with submissions routed to a project or the org's private Feedback list. Nothing shows a hosted public portal, public listing of ideas, or customer voting. The widget is a related but different intake feature, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can host a public feedback portal where customers submit and vote on ideas
